name: Birdeye
description: Birdeye is a multi-location customer-experience and reputation platform covering reviews, listings, social publishing, messaging, surveys, local visibility, marketing automation, ticketing, and AI-assisted customer engagement.
best_for: Multi-location brands and local businesses that want reviews, listings, messaging, social, surveys, and reputation workflows managed from one platform.
features: Review management and review generation across locations
Messaging, texting, chatbot, surveys, insights, and ticketing
Marketing automation and AI-assisted local discovery tools

pricing.starting_price: Custom — based on deployed products, locations, and contract structure

tiers.name: Custom platform package
tiers.notes: Birdeye states pricing is customized by products selected, number of locations, and contract structure rather than a fixed seat price.

pros: One platform spans reviews, listings, social, messaging, surveys, and local visibility
Pricing is structured around deployed capabilities and locations rather than seats
cons: Breadth can be more than a single-location business needs
Exact package economics require a sales conversation

alternatives.name: Sprout Social
alternatives.description: Social media management and analytics platform for publishing, engagement, and reporting.
alternatives.best_for: Brands prioritizing social media operations over broader reputation/listings workflows.

alternatives.name: Hootsuite
alternatives.description: Social media management platform for scheduling, monitoring, and team workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Teams focused primarily on multi-network social management.
